Four people who disagree about AI safety, and a room to understand them. Everybody is welcome, because this involves everybody.

## Why now

In July, OpenAI's models broke out of a test environment and hacked into a real company, Hugging Face. They did it on their own. *[[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/07/21/openai-says-ai-models-escaped-control-hacked-hugging-face/)*

In September, Anthropic reported the other danger. State spies and criminal gangs already use its AI to attack governments and companies. *[[2]](https://www.anthropic.com/threat-intelligence-report-september-2026)*

On 3 September, two members of the US Congress introduced a bill to ban superintelligent AI. *[[3]](https://www.sanders.senate.gov/press-releases/news-sanders-casar-introduce-legislation-to-ban-artificial-superintelligence-and-temporarily-pause-advanced-ai-development/)*

## Agenda

1. Introduction and a live demonstration of the *[Clarity Meeting Principle](https://claritypledge.com/meet)*.
2. Everybody takes a position on *[four contested points about AI safety](https://claritypledge.com/stake/aisafety1)*.
3. Conversations in groups of three, a few rounds. Everybody takes turns as speaker, listener and observer.
4. Questions and answers.

We welcome critical feedback. If you think the structure or the points are wrong, say so at the event.

## Prepare for the event

To prepare, read the stories of four well-known people with divergent opinions on AI safety:

- **Bernie Sanders**, US senator, wants superintelligent AI banned.
- **Yann LeCun**, AI researcher, thinks the danger is overstated.
- **Yoshua Bengio**, AI researcher, warns about losing control.
- **Connor Leahy**, founder of an AI safety company, wants development paused.

**[Read their stories and take your position on the four points](https://claritypledge.com/stake/aisafety1?tab=stories)**

## How Clarity Nights are different

In many groups, saying "I did not understand you" makes you look stupid. So people hide gaps in their understanding. A gap you hide cannot be bridged. At our events, revealing a gap in your understanding is rewarded, not punished.

This event is organized by the *[Communication Activism Community](https://claritypledge.com/groups/cm)*.
